info.name: SASE 5G Monitor Service API
info.description:
The SASE 5G Monitoring Service provides real-time visibility and technical telemetry 
for enterprise 5G infrastructure within the Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) ecosystem. 
Technical leads and network analysts utilize these APIs to track subscriber scaling, 
monitor regional registration trends, and audit network throughput performance.

By leveraging these endpoints, organizations maintain a continuous feedback loop on 
User Equipment (UE) activity and regional interconnect health. The service enables 
proactive troubleshooting through incident severity tracking and API performance 
monitoring, ensuring that global 5G connectivity meets strict service level objectives 
while identifying unauthorized traffic or signaling gaps. This spec was created on February 13, 2026. © 2026 Palo Alto Networks, Inc.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Fetch Tenant Totals

request.description:
Returns the aggregate count of onboarded tenants across the 5G service 
infrastructure. Monitoring teams call this during system audits to verify 
the scale of the multi-tenant environment within the management plane.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Analyze Registration Trends

request.description:
Generates a time-series report of subscriber registration activities over 
a specific time window. Engineers utilize these trends during capacity 
planning to identify peak usage intervals and regional registration spikes 
within the management plane.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Count Registered Devices

request.description:
Provides the current number of registered User Equipment (UE) device 
mappings within the 5G network. Network operators perform this check to 
assess active device density and ensure session registration alignment 
across all 5G nodes.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks List Active Regions

request.description:
Lists all compute regions currently hosting registered 5G User Equipment. 
Infrastructure architects query this during regional performance analysis 
to determine where subscriber traffic is geographically concentrated.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Track Deregistration Trends

request.description:
Monitors the frequency and volume of User Equipment session terminations 
over time. Security analysts use this telemetry to detect anomalous 
disconnect patterns or regional connectivity drops during active 
monitoring windows.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Audit Mapping Changes

request.description:
Calculates the number of newly added and cleared User Equipment IP Address 
mappings for a designated period. System administrators trigger this 
audit to track device churn and verify lifecycle transitions within 
the 5G management plane.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Identify Unknown Regions

request.description:
Returns a list of regions where IP Address addresses not explicitly mapped to 
known User Equipment have been detected. Security teams check these 
locations to investigate potential unauthorized traffic or misconfigured 
5G signaling paths.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Monitor Unknown Trends

request.description:
Tracks the volume of unknown IP Address address detections over a historical 
time range. Network engineers monitor these trends to troubleshoot 
discovery gaps and improve the accuracy of subscriber mapping across 
regional interconnects.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Check Active Mappings

request.description:
Displays the total number of User Equipment mappings currently in an 
active state. Monitoring dashboards use this metric to provide a 
real-time snapshot of 5G session health and operational throughput 
readiness.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Verify Configured Mappings

request.description:
Returns the count of User Equipment mappings manually provisioned by 
administrators. Operational leads compare this value against active 
registrations to verify onboarding success and subscriber provisioning 
accuracy.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Detect Unconfigured Subscribers

request.description:
Reports the count of User Equipment that successfully registered via 
Radius or Application Programming Interface but lack a predefined configuration. Analysts review 
these mappings to bridge gaps between dynamic 5G sessions and static 
management records.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get 5G Mapping Regions

request.description: Returns the list of regions where mappings exist.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Search Subscriber Details

request.description:
Provides a comprehensive search interface for User Equipment mappings 
using IMSI, IMEI, or IP Address address identifiers. Developers integrate this 
to enable granular drill-downs into subscriber metadata, tenant 
provisioning status, and group associations.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Count Active Proxies

request.description:
Returns the total number of proxy servers configured to handle 5G 
control plane traffic. Administrators audit this count during 
infrastructure maintenance to ensure all intended signaling gateways 
are recognized by the monitoring service.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Categorize Incident Severities

request.description:
Aggregates active 5G service incidents based on critical, warning, or 
informational severity levels. NOC engineers use this data during 
incident response windows to prioritize remediation efforts across 
the global 5G fabric.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Monitor Application Programming Interface Performance

request.description:
Returns success and failure statistics for 5G management Application Programming Interface calls made 
through the SCM interface. Technical teams monitor these stats to 
ensure high availability and detect potential integration issues 
between 5G cores and the management plane.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Inspect Interconnect Health

request.description:
Provides a detailed overview of 5G network interconnects, including 
total bandwidth and regional VLAN status. Network engineers utilize 
this check to verify that regional data paths remain "up" and meet 
throughput capacity requirements.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Analyze Throughput Performance

request.description:
Generates egress and ingress throughput metrics for 5G interconnects 
over a requested interval. Analysts monitor these throughput levels 
to detect congestion points and optimize traffic flow across the 
regional security perimeter.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Fetch User Totals

request.description:
Reports the total number of users configured within the 5G monitoring 
domain. Management teams use this count for license auditing and 
to track the growth of the subscriber base across the multi-tenant 
environment.
